Estimated annual gross income$0

How much do real estate agents make in South Daytona?

There’s no salary. Agents earn a commission on each sale, so income scales with how much you sell. The math: each deal pays the sale price × the commission rate × your side of the deal (usually 50%) × your brokerage split. Multiply by the number of deals you close in a year and you have your gross. The calculator above assumes a 50% side, adjust the other numbers to your situation.

What moves the number most in South Daytona?

Two levers dominate: volume (more closings) and price point (higher-value markets). The Volusia County median, which covers South Daytona, is about $343,000, and roughly 900 homes sell each month countywide, so the volume is there for an agent who can find clients. South Daytona’s affordability relative to that county median, being a smaller, largely residential mainland community, tends to draw steady first-time and value-conscious buyers, which gives an agent working there a consistent, if modest, base of transactions to build on.

What the estimate doesn’t include

This is a gross figure. Out of it come brokerage fees, the marketing you pay for, MLS and board dues, and self-employment taxes. That’s exactly why a new agent’s real take-home depends so much on the brokerage: one that includes marketing and tools and helps you get clients faster can mean more closings and lower costs than a higher split where you fund everything. See how to become a real estate agent in South Daytona.

This estimator is a simplified gross projection and not a guarantee of income. It ignores fees, taxes, and market variation. Educational only, not financial advice.

faq.q: How much do real estate agents make in South Daytona?
faq.a: It varies widely because income is commission-based. As a rough estimate, multiply deals per year by average sale price, the commission rate, your side of the deal (usually 50%), and your brokerage split. At the ~$343,000 Volusia County median, 12 deals a year at 5% total, a 50% side, and a 70% split is about $72,000 gross before fees and taxes.

faq.q: Do real estate agents get a salary in South Daytona?
faq.a: No. Almost all South Daytona real estate agents are independent contractors paid by commission on each closed sale, not a salary. Income depends entirely on production.

faq.q: How can a new agent in South Daytona increase their first-year income?
faq.a: Close more deals, faster. That comes from training, lead and marketing support, and a recognized brand, which is why the brokerage you join matters more than the headline split in year one.
